تتعاطي (form VI)
# تَتَعَاطَيْ (tataʕāṭay) /ta.ta.ʕaː.tˤaj/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of تَعَاطَى (taʕāṭā)
# تُتَعَاطَيْ (tutaʕāṭay) /tu.ta.ʕaː.tˤaj/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of تَعَاطَى (taʕāṭā)
